blocks.tamil_translation: is more beloved to Allah. Rather than eight persons praying separately, four persons praying together is more beloved to Allah. Rather than a hundred persons praying separately, eight persons praying with the congregation is more beloved to Allah,” Hazrat Qubath ibn Ashyam Laithi (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ صَلَاةَ الرَّجُلِ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ أَزْكَي مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَصَلَاتَهُ مَعَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ أَزْكَي مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ، وَمَاكَثُرَ فَهُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَي اللهِ .
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهوبعض الحديث) رواه ابوداؤد باب في فضل صلوة الجماعة رقم:٥٥٤. سنن ابي داؤد طبع دار الباز للنشر والتوزيع
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ubayy ibn Ka'b (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “A person praying in congregation together with one other person is better than his praying alone. Three persons praying in congregation is better than two persons praying in congregation. In the same way, the larger the gathering in congregational Salah, the more beloved it is to Allah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِنِ الْخُدْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلصَّلَاةُ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ تَعْدِلُ خَمْساً وَّعِشْرِينَ صَلَاةً فَإِذَا صَلَّاهَا فِي فَلَاةٍ فَأَتَمَّ رُكُوعَهَا وَسُجُودَهَا بَلَغَتْ خَمْسِينَ صَلَاةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب ماجاء في فضل المشي الي الصلوة رقم:٥٦٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The reward of praying in congregation is equal to twenty-five Salahs; if a person prays in the wilderness, performing the ruku' and sujud perfectly (reciting the tasbihs calmly), the reward of his Salah reaches fifty Salahs.”
